Decisions

  • All decisions
  • 0001 · Shared C++ engine behind a C API
  • 0002 · Four output topologies; Bluetooth is master only
  • 0003 · Obsidian is the default design system; users can change its look
  • 0004 · Split is the primary mark; Pulse is a supporting element
  • 0005 · Adopt Station 1.2.1 as an internal, small-shape repository
  • 0006 · Automatic transitions start on the next phrase
  • 0007 · One shared library; named sessions; imports copied in
  • 0008 · A vinyl platter model in the engine
  • 0009 · Visualizer from the master tap, on its own screen

Security

Report a vulnerability privately through GitHub: open the repository's Security tab and choose Report a vulnerability, or go to https://github.com/aidenlive/Soundboard/security/advisories/new. Do not open a public issue.

Include the platform and version, steps to reproduce, and what an attacker gains.

Scope

In scopeNotes
The apps (iOS, Android, macOS)File import, security-scoped bookmarks, audio file parsing
The engine (engine/)Memory safety in decoding hand-off, analysis and the real-time path
Build and CI configuration.github/, deploy/, Makefile, tools/

The apps have no server, accounts or network API in 0.1.0. Sync (planned, see ROADMAP.md) will extend this scope when it ships.

Supported versions

Only the latest version on main receives fixes while the project is in draft.

Source: SECURITY.md
